entities.name: Baltic German Autonomy & Serfdom
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Ritterschaft (Baltic German noble corporations) governed local affairs. Estonian peasant serfdom under the Gutswirtschaft system. The Moravian Brethren mission bringing literacy to peasants. The 'good peasant laws' of the 1760s–80s proved largely ineffective.
